description: Random events that occur between dungeon waves. Each has 2-4 choices with different outcomes.

events.name: Mysterious Chest
events.description: A dust-covered chest sits in an alcove, its lock glowing faintly. Something rattles inside.

bad.message: A poison needle trap! The party takes damage.

good.message: The rogue expertly disarms the trap and finds extra treasure!

bad.message: The lock mechanism snaps — minor injury.

result.message: The chest shatters into useful crafting materials.

events.name: Wounded Traveler
events.description: A wounded adventurer leans against the wall, clutching a bleeding wound. They look up with desperate eyes.

result.message: Grateful, they share knowledge of enemy weaknesses. Party ATK +10%!
Grateful, they teach defensive techniques. Party DEF +10%!
You take their remaining gold... but feel terrible about it.

events.name: Poison Gas Trap
events.description: Green mist seeps from cracks in the floor. The air burns your throat. You must act quickly.

result.message: The party charges through, taking poison damage!

good.message: Trap disarmed! The gas dissipates harmlessly.

bad.message: The disarm fails — concentrated blast hits everyone!

result.message: The gas lingers... everyone feels sluggish. SPD -15% for 3 combats.

events.name: Ancient Shrine
events.description: A crumbling shrine radiates faint energy. Offerings and prayers litter the base of a forgotten idol.

bad.message: The shrine curses you! Mag DEF -10% for 3 combats.

result.message: Warm light washes over the party. HP restored!
The idol breaks apart into rare materials!

events.name: Fork in the Road
events.description: The tunnel splits. Left is darker and ominous. Right shows flickering torchlight.

result.message: The enemies ahead are stronger... but the rewards will be greater.
An easier route. The enemies seem weaker here.

events.name: Trapped Floor
events.description: The floor tiles have suspicious markings. Some are clearly pressure plates.

bad.message: CLICK. A dart hits one party member!

result.message: A fireball safely detonates all the traps at once.
The warrior shrugs off the darts with their heavy armor.

events.name: Wandering Merchant
events.description: A hooded figure sits cross-legged with trinkets spread on a cloth. 'Care to try your luck, adventurer?'

result.message: The merchant hands you a wrapped package...

good.message: You win! Double your gold back!

bad.message: You lose. The merchant grins and pockets your gold.

result.message: The merchant shares combat tips. Party crit rate +5%!

events.name: Underground Spring
events.description: Crystal-clear water bubbles up from the rocks, glowing with a faint blue light. It looks refreshing.

good.message: The water is incredibly refreshing! Party healed!

bad.message: The water tastes odd... everyone feels weakened.
